payload.title: The last comment before a restatement
payload.question: In a discussion of about five people, is the comment immediately before a person restates a view more associated with the direction of that restatement than the first disagreeing comment?
payload.claim: People answer the latest turn, not the strongest objection, when the group is small enough that every comment stays on screen.
payload.population: A small experiment. Groups of five, one short prompt, and one restatement from each person.
payload.outcome: Whether the restatement moves toward the last comment or toward the first disagreement.
payload.why_it_might_be_nonobvious: Recency is a common survey result. It is less clear that recency beats the first objection inside a group that can still see both.

payload.objection: The last-comment effect may be the person answering whoever is still active in the thread. A design that closes the thread before the restatement would separate recency from interruption.
payload.alternative: Freeze the comment list, then ask for the restatement on the next screen.

payload.objection: A five-person group still has a majority. The restatement may move toward the side with more speakers, and the last comment is only a stand-in for that side.
payload.alternative: Hold the count of disagreeing speakers at one, and vary only whether that speaker is first or last.

payload.objection: Ask for the opinion in the thread and again on a private item. Public agreement with the last speaker is a different outcome from a private update.
payload.alternative: Use the same numeric scale for the public statement and the private item.

payload.objection: Record order and timestamps. If two comments arrive close together, last is not well defined.
payload.alternative: Store the gap in seconds between the last two comments, and drop pairs that land inside two seconds.

payload.objection: Vary whether the last speaker is the same person who disagreed first. Otherwise recency and first dissent can be the same speaker.
payload.alternative: Cross last-versus-first with same-speaker versus different-speaker.

payload.objection: A party label would swamp a recency test. The party-cue study is a separate round and should stay out of this design.
payload.alternative: Ban party names and news-outlet names from the stimulus comments.

payload.objection: The private item has to use the same endpoints as the statement in the thread, or the gap is not interpretable.
payload.alternative: Copy the scale wording onto the private item and change only the privacy instruction.

payload.objection: A session that runs until someone restates will over-sample people who like the last word.
payload.alternative: Publish a stopping rule before the sessions. End the thread after the assigned comments, then ask for the restatement.
